summary.reason: All active requirements are stable and the SRS validates cleanly, but implementation has high sequencing risk across persistence, native dependencies, background jobs, security redaction, MCP contracts, and UI.

conditions: Implement one shared redaction utility before save_document or smart_search external responses.
Update stdio, HTTP, and bundled MCP tool contracts together from 6 tools to 8 tools.
Reject unknown import/indexing/reconciliation control fields in MCP payloads.
Treat SQLite as source-of-truth ledger for Wave 2 documents, chunks, links, jobs, source identity, and embedding metadata.
Keep raw absolute paths internal and expose only documentId, source-relative path, redacted token, counts, and diagnostic codes.
Add migration/recovery tests before background indexing starts using the ledger.
Settings UI must show unset, connected, and unreachable model states.
Chunk defaults must be 900 tokens and 120 overlap across UI, config, fingerprint, and index enqueue.
Live endpoint examples must be read from gitignored model-api.txt for tests only.
Add hnswlib-node as a native dependency and gate release packaging with a load/add/search smoke test.
Use atomic derived-index swap and keyword-only degraded mode when native HNSW is unavailable.
Update electron-builder native unpack/rebuild behavior.
Broken links are non-blocking diagnostic edges, not indexing failures.
Only resolved edges may affect ranking or linkedTo/linkedFrom filters.
Do not inject synthetic broken/missing tokens into BM25/FTS.
Indexing controls remain Settings-only and are not MCP tools.
save_document stays content-only/no-viewer and must not start recursive linked import.
Bounded linked local import belongs to Settings or source-path-backed local import workflow.
Duplicate prevention must use source identity and transaction/upsert boundaries, not absolute destination path alone.
Existing knowledge-store Markdown files are adopted without rewrite.
Keep verified Korean garu-ko tokenizer behavior compatible with the new hybrid search pipeline.
Do not weaken Wave 1 or Wave 1.5 compatibility contracts while adding smart_search.

cleanup_notes: FR-DOC-022 has stale prose mentioning discarded REL-DOC-003; planner should treat REL-DOC-004 as active recovery policy.
The implementation plan should start with redaction and ledger tests because many later requirements depend on them.
